import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_4.csv')
# z-score within each (account, service) group
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
mean = g.transform('mean')
std = g.transform('std')

top = df.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(10)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']])

tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_4.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
med = g.transform('median')
mad = (df['BilledCost']-med).abs().groupby([df.SubAccountName, df.ServiceName]).transform('median')
df['robust_z'] = 0.6745*(df['BilledCost']-med)/mad
print(df.sort_values('robust_z', ascending=False).head(5)[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','robust_z']])
